scope: 116 official FHS PDFs (1471 physical pages) selected by no_terminal_receipt in FHS_INITIAL_CAMPAIGN_QUOTA_20261120.json.
currentMethod: Read already settled organizer/reviewer stages by the original operation, observation and request hashes. Replay whole PDFs in network-disabled Linux with the official files and Git LF prompts. Stop when the independent reviewer is requested. No new generation, embedding, publication or family record.
originalConstraints: The combined nine or twelve conditions and two age holds retain their original limits. The third HTTP 504 remains reserved in the sole campaign. The 102 remaining sources are the frozen scope minus the 14 listed and have no source result at this checkpoint.

retainedRecovery.target: firebase-server, Node 24.19.0, built locally from Git LF sources; read-only container, network disabled
retainedRecovery.originalParents: Six production parents checked read-only: same registered operation, first observation, original PDF SHA, exactly one settled organizer, candidate held without lease, prepared draft or publication receipt.
retainedRecovery.result: Each explicit ID and original operation selects one packaged recovery. Its original stage was replayed against the same request, and its independent reviewer received the complete hash-checked PDF and the source-specific page notes. Dispatch intercepted before calling a provider. The original default recovery queue retains its 24 held and 15 previously published entries.
retainedRecovery.integration: The first Windows build context had CRLF prompt bytes and correctly failed the original organizer-request guard. The repeat used Git LF source bytes and matched all six reviewer request hashes. The original 504 was refused before opening persistence. The fresh-draft test now observes HK reaching review, and the retained-draft test still checks the unchanged original organizer. Five focused tests and the server TypeScript project passed.

posterFollowup.scope: Three sources held for discrepancies between independent transcriptions. Both original model outputs and their actual sections remain unchanged.

accepted.locator: 第 1 頁左上淺藍區，兩組年齡與對應的屏幕時間
accepted.reason: 原審核轉錄包含整理者選取的整段。原頁兩組年齡的文字及右方時間圖示均可重開核對。

stillHeld.reason: A complete caption in the lower left panel occurs in both transcriptions. The page prints ages 1–2 and 3–4 alongside sleep times; the stored draft and review extend 12–59 months to the whole day. An excerpt-only recovery cannot resolve the whole-unit scope.
The second page has two disjoint independently chosen paragraphs. The original quote mismatch remains.

verification.source: The original immutable slice and both settled request hashes were verified before offline replay. Visual review compared the printed age groups, labels and time icon on the public original.
verification.exercise: In a network-disabled worker with in-memory Firestore and an isolated registry for its synthetic watch identifiers, the parent held on the original mismatch. The child reread both stages, generated zero model calls, wrote one synthetic vector, listed one edition, and reopened the hash-checked original through a synthetic saved citation. Repetition added zero vectors. The release registry admits the screen poster and rejects the daily-routine poster before opening persistence.
verification.negative: Unregistered containment, a changed offset, different wording, different request hash, and an independent hold were rejected. Server TypeScript and five focused tests passed.
verification.production: The registered poster was recovered using both existing readings and zero new generation. Its live published edition, one vector, the physical first page of the original, and the complete excerpt at both registered transcript offsets were verified in the production worker.

firstLiveDelivery.verification: The production card catalogue, reviewed active version, committed receipt, original parent, reviewed PDF hash and distinct native-reading keys were checked. Exported the exact edition and its stored document vector. Reopened each PDF using the production resolver and a synthetic saved-run boundary, verified the original SHA-256, then located the entire displayed excerpt on its physical page in the matching original. The readback used no family session.

originalAwaitingReviewer.owner: The original campaign operator scheduled the same operation on the next UTC day.

remainingWithoutModelOrEdition.evidence: Read the active version pointer and the counts of existing generation/embedding attempts for every listed source in the public campaign. None of these 84 had a provider attempt or an active edition. Six exceed the per-work native reading limit.

dailyAdmissionCheckpoint.verification: The other 20-page PDF verified in this campaign belongs to the earlier C2 list and is excluded. Both 24-page C3 sources still have no provider attempt or published version.

productionCache.scope: The complete verified cache and archives remain on the operator workstation. The worker can open original PDFs with the small text-layer index. A selected source bundle also supplies all its pinned native attachments and is reclaimable when its command exits.

publicationLaneInputs.method: The source fetcher's leaflet reader verified each frozen original and selected whole or windowed input. Every parent range, native PDF attachment and inner text-layer range came from the authenticated parser cache. The production worker opened the installed index after checking both archive digests and all 408 records. No provider was called during staging.

c3FirstCommissionedDispatch.evidence: The production lane selected the pinned original. A read-only Firestore query matched its one generation reservation to that operation. No settlement or family delivery was verified at this checkpoint. The public site and IAP stopped responding during the run.

afterVmRestart.method: At one Firestore read time, matched all 28 assigned operation fingerprints against their original work and candidate records, source heads and campaign attempts. The single generation reservation belongs to the 24-page guide. The disconnected command returned no provider result.

c3CommissionedResults.method: The bounded production entry used each assigned original operation. Published rows match the active family card, every required document vector and the physical opening page in the frozen PDF. A held row pairs the production decision with a separate receipt. Rows marked production_decision_and_firestore_readback match that decision to the original work, candidate, card head and tickets at one Firestore read time. Unsettled provider reservations remain attached to their originals.

firstWindowOrganizerSchemas.method: Captured the native organizer response schema offline before the provider call, using the registered source, original first PDF attachment, production range plan and explicit age setting. The 80-, 84- and 96-page editions have the same four-range first-window schema. HTTP 400 receipts do not specify which input field was rejected.

initialScopeReadback.method: Joined the 09:00 source list and original lane bindings to source heads, work markers and provider tickets at one Firestore read time. For every active edition the earlier family readback matches the exact live version, exported vector count and physical citation proof. An original work marker alone supplies no terminal disposition. Ticket counts under the earlier C group describe the source history; the 84 lane sources are bound to their original operation.

fourProviderResponses.rule: A returned HTTP 400 carries no input or output token charge under the published Google Cloud rule. The November 13 timeout provision concerns Gemini 4 completions above 32K tokens. Each of these four original requests had one authenticated SDK error and one matching original generation reservation.
fourProviderResponses.accounting: The original C production coordinator now owns reconciliation of the four identified reservations against the original source, operation, stage and ticket. Token usage was not returned. No zero-token measurement or ledger settlement is asserted. The 24-page bottle-feeding request had no matched provider response and is excluded.

ownerReceiptReadback.method: Apply changedEntries by sourceId over initialScopeReadback.entries. Rejoined all 116 original hashes, current source heads and tickets at one timestamp. C1 and C2 owner evidence supplies each later disposition, vector export and page proof. Earlier C and C3 editions retain the same live version and ticket counts.

longCandidate.title: 6至24個月嬰幼兒健康飲食(2)進展篇(上)小冊子
longCandidate.selection: Of the 12 in-scope PDFs over 20 pages, this is the unstarted original with the fewest planned reading stages. The other 24-page whole PDF has an unanswered reservation.
longCandidate.verification: Rebuilt the normal organizer request locally. Its attached bytes match the complete frozen 24-page PDF, its four physical ranges cover all pages, and its observation hash and original operation match the production owner receipt. The capture stopped before provider dispatch. A provider read, independent approval, vector export, active edition and live citations remain pending.

rejectionSettlementReadback.verifiedAgainst: All 116 source heads, original work presence and provider tickets were compared to ownerReceiptReadback. Only the five original reservations listed here changed state. All five returned the stored native HTTP 400 evidence and settled at zero charge with no reported token counts.

heldWindowInspectionInputs.method: Prepared seven original page-text blocks under the registered parser and verified every record after archive readback. Each of the six failed original first windows has two distinct, settled generation tickets with output. The organizer stage hash matches the normally reconstructed PDF request. The paired excerpts and any publication outcome await the released read-only inspector.

wholePdfReleaseCompatibility.reviewInput: Same synthetic organizer fixture for the independent request comparison only; no provider dispatch or content acceptance.
wholePdfReleaseCompatibility.selection: These three C2 originals were deferred pending a dense-window worker release. Each matching production status receipt at 14:41–14:42 HKT showed an unstarted source. Their registered observations use the whole-PDF route in both revisions.
wholePdfReleaseCompatibility.method: Unpacked the two Git revisions separately. Each revision reconstructed both request envelopes with the complete frozen attachment. The normal organizer request and the independent request using the same synthetic organizer output have the same bytes and schemas across revisions. The real provider read, verdict and edition remain unverified until original production dispatch.

interruptedOrganizerReadback.sourceProof: The complete 24-page organizer input was reconstructed locally from the frozen bytes and original observation. The historical prompt bytes match the original generation stage hash and ticket. The stage was created pending and never updated. Its last write predates the dispatch reservation, and no prepared candidate exists.
interruptedOrganizerReadback.resolution: The two successful project-level calls have neither source nor operation keys. Their token counts cannot be assigned to the original source, and neither response body is available here. Retain the reservation and do not redispatch this operation.

afterProductionRelease.method: Compared original source heads and tickets at both read times. Matched three previously prepared whole-PDF organizer requests to production tickets, stage metadata and original worker outputs. The 24-page source received HTTP 504. A source-level finalized reading, independent review, embeddings and edition are absent. The 16-page original has one settled organizer with output tokens and no independent reviewer provider ticket.

longOriginalsWithoutProviderTickets.method: For the 80-page original, the contemporaneous account versions match at work creation and final hold. The C3 balance after that work and the C1 balance immediately after the 40-page terminal decision have identical cumulative reservation and settlement counters, limit, spend and held totals. The four other work intervals fall between those two balances. The original entry point reserves before calling the model. The per-source terminal code does not specify a more precise cause.

originalLongWindowBindings.method: Matched each original first organizer stage address to a request reconstructed from its parent hash, registered physical ranges, schema, historical prompt and source-specific stored PDF slice hash. Three slice hashes also match the private local packets byte for byte. The 32- and 40-page originals use different stored slice bytes; their local packets do not substitute for their registered inputs.

compatiblePreparedSource.result: All 36 original core pages and their neighboring context are present. The original and current window ranges are identical. The original terminal work remains held with no provider ticket. These checks provide no model reading or authorization to reopen the work.
